mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real sales indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1600 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
